task_population: 22 independent synthetic/offline behavioral challenges of public CLIs; not model-quality or production-price evidence

rules.scoring: one binary contract outcome per independent challenge; extension unsupported old excluded from shared-quality denominator, reported separately; frozen_new and repaired_new never combined
rules.repairs: After viewing frozen outputs all repaired reruns and follow-on variants are validation, not untouched holdout
rules.failure_coverage: No skipped hard cases or infrastructure failures scored as application quality; harness failures called out

challenges.name: legacy-text-subsets
challenges.expected: Legacy normalized input/cache/output/reasoning is priced once: USD 10.2, full total 10.2.

challenges.name: unknown-and-partial
challenges.expected: Unknown model and partial usage prevent total_cost_usd; retain known subtotal.

challenges.name: distinct-endpoint-rates
challenges.expected: Same model decisions input-only prices USD2; responses text USD10.2; old exact-scoped adapter absent is unsupported.

challenges.name: explicit-endpoint-no-legacy-fallback
challenges.expected: A legacy price card plus explicitly different endpoint must return unknown; never model-only fallback.

challenges.name: native-modality-not-free
challenges.expected: Legacy normalized text plus native audio detail must be unknown rather than text-only complete cost.

challenges.name: duplicate-normalization-conflict
challenges.expected: Flat/detail cache counters 200000 versus 100000 must reject before pricing.

challenges.name: cache-write-subset
challenges.expected: Explicit write subset is subtracted from ordinary input, added at write rate; expected USD10.6. Unsupported old accounting is separate.

challenges.name: clean-confusion-matrix
challenges.expected: Both sides retain exact TP2/TN2/FP1/FN1, agreement 2/3, recall2/3, precision2/3, order inconsistency0.

challenges.name: absent-negative-controls
challenges.expected: A perfect positive-only set is not ready_for_review and negative evidence is unmeasured.

challenges.name: contradictory-adjudication
challenges.expected: Same case human adjudication changing between repeats must reject.

challenges.name: rare-base-rate
challenges.expected: 100 positives90TP10FN,900 negatives18FP882TN: FPR.02,FNR.1, deployment PPV.04310344827586207 at prevalence .001; old flag absent unsupported.

challenges.name: fixed-judge-drift
challenges.expected: Same judge/rubric across cohorts, negatives FPR .02 to .08, max increase .03: alert and delta .06. Old drift flag absent unsupported.

challenges.name: paired-judge-change
challenges.expected: Identical cases/rubric/adjudication: one improved, one regressed, paired agreement delta0; old baseline flag absent unsupported.

challenges.name: clean-real-run-and-compare
challenges.expected: Two deterministic app variants via run_eval complete with2 pairs; quality delta1 and identity verified.

challenges.name: served-model-substitution
challenges.expected: Pinned model mismatch yields zero scores, serving_substitution, retained USD.02 cost.

challenges.name: short-stage-population
challenges.expected: Contract workers3/aggregate1, reported workers2/aggregate1: unscorable coverage_incomplete; old stage gate absent unsupported.

challenges.name: served-tier-substitution
challenges.expected: Pinned standard tier, served flex at same model: zero scores, serving_substitution, retained USD.02; old billing scope pin absent unsupported.

challenges.name: failure-budget-and-resume
challenges.expected: Failed ceiling1, retry-safe app/retries1/attempts4: exactly1 failed invocation; resume does not launch more, remains incomplete. Old failure-limit absent unsupported.

challenges.name: interrupted-report-accounting
challenges.expected: Started attempt without finish/result has unknown outcome/spend; report total_cost_usd must be null and unknown_cost_attempts1; report counts attempted invocation.

challenges.name: transplanted-report-ownership
challenges.expected: Rehashed result whose treatment binding belongs elsewhere must have unverified report integrity. Old per-result binding absent unsupported; frozen new is tested for this claim.

challenges.name: unreconciled-resume
challenges.expected: Open started attempt blocks resume with explicit reconciliation error and no new application call.

challenges.name: abandoned-reconciliation-budget
challenges.expected: Externally documented abandoned attempt consumes failed ceiling after reconcile --apply; resume cannot launch more. Old failure ceiling absent unsupported.
